items.name: Clock on the Madison Rocks 2025

venue.name: Tenney Park [Saturday], Highland Manor Park [Friday]
venue.address: 402 N Thornton Ave, Madison, WI 53703 [Saturday], 10 Manor Dr, Madison, WI 53713 [Friday]

items.information: ### Friday Events: 6x6, Megaminx, Square-1, 3x3 with Feet ### Saturday Events: 3x3, Clock, Pyraminx, Skewb ### If you are not competing in any of Friday's events, you only need to attend the competition on Saturday. If you will not be attending the competition on Friday, please do not sign up for any Friday events. This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association.](https://www.midwestcubing.org/) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dEIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a6239c56608b03fda2194e41dd545ce91819975d/MCA-Final-Logo%20(WCA%20website%20version).png)

items.name: Polish Open 2025
items.information: ![](https://i.imgur.com/y4aZ08M.png) **Polski:** Zapraszamy na jubileuszową edycję turnieju Polish Open, którego historia sięga 2005 roku! **Te zawody nie są Mistrzostwami Polski** - jest to otwarta impreza bez limitów rejestracyjnych stanowiąca przedsmak i rozgrzewkę przed Mistrzostwami Polski. Zawody zostały objęte patronatem honorowym Starosty Powiatu Dębickiego Piotra Chęćka, Burmistrza Dębicy Mateusza Kutrzeby oraz Wójta Gminy Dębica Adama Pieniążka! ---- ![](https://i.imgur.com/i1ldA95.png) **English:** We invite you to the anniversary Polish Open competition! **This is NOT the Polish Championship** - it is a warm-up tournament before the Polish Championship but without registration limits. The competition is held under honorary patronage of Powiat Dębicki, Dębica City and Dębica Commune Mayors: Piotr Chęciek, Mateusz Kutrzeba and Adam Pieniążek! ![](https://i.imgur.com/3kbKW5e.png)

items.name: Rubik's Dutch Nationals 2025
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6OTgyOTUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--a495716f2dd251b23a825b33ffb2e3ae433bb6fd/LogoDutchNats2025.jpg) Dit is het officiële Nederlandse Kampioenschap. De wedstrijd staat open voor kubussers met alle nationaliteiten. Alleen Nederlandse deelnemers kunnen prijzen en titels winnen. Voor finales (behalve gecombineerde) gaat top 14 door. Dit is top 14 Nederlanders. Iedereen die sneller is dan de 14e Nederlander gaat ook nog door. op Gasten zijn welkom. _____ This is the official Dutch Championship. The competition is open to cubers from all countries. Only Dutch competitors can win prizes and awards. For finals (except combined finals) the top 14 will advance. This means top 14 Dutch. Everyone that is faster than the 14th Dutch will also advance. Guests are welcome. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTAxNTAyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--5f449224b6a1f99c35b97779beee5e86bd122fa8/SCN%20logo%20final.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTExNjY1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a5689d400e5b8808c8fee0c15b6e75cc4f2db64b/Rubiks%20Logo.png)
